prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Zoe. Kit MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Sort Them Again; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: World Discovery classroom table in daylight; Zoe sorts six large craft buttons on a pale blue mat.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Exactly six round four-hole buttons: one large red, two small red, two large blue, one small blue; One pale blue mat with no printed words; Two empty shallow trays
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Six total; two sizes and two colors; four holes on each button; no pouring container needed.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: World Discovery classroom table in daylight; Zoe sorts six large craft buttons on a pale blue mat. Zoe spreads exactly six craft buttons on the pale blue mat: one large red, two small red, two large blue and one small blue. Both shallow trays beside the mat are empty. Exact state: Six total; two sizes and two colors; four holes on each button; no pouring container needed.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
CRITICAL REFERENCE BOARD: Zoe model only; NO Kit. Six isolated button models grouped on white: ONE large red, TWO small red, TWO large blue, ONE small blue. Exactly FOUR round holes in every button. Large buttons diameter twice small ones. Show one plain pale blue mat and exactly two empty shallow neutral silver trays separately. EMPTY classroom table location key; NO buttons, Zoe, child, mat or tray inside that key. No text or decorative counters.

visualReview.note: Zoe, exact six four-hole buttons in required color and size counts, plain blue mat, two silver trays and empty classroom table inspected.
